question: In a certain code language, RICE is written as 73. How will FLOUR be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/094413ca23e189e59a3d82079258703e8647a6aa49a3c37196c6d31304d23587.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

 
• Addition of the positional values of the opposite letters.
 
• R → opposite is I
 
• I → opposite is R
 
• C &
